payload.title: Move model discovery and readiness queries behind the parent-private Models catalog
currentProgress: CTR-MOD is terminal and accepted: pkg/services/models exposes one injected root Service with scoped ListCatalog, GetCatalogModel, and GetModelReadiness operations.
IMP-MOD-01 is terminal and accepted: runtime scopes are parent-private, explicitly opened and closed, and represented to callers by opaque RuntimeScopeRef values.

Legacy catalog behavior remains split across pkg/services/models/internal/local/catalog.go, internal/service catalog/readiness adapters, internal/host catalog behavior, and compatibility root methods.
The active CLI lifecycle owner leases CLI manifest, generated API artifacts, root/run/server lifecycle, docs, and broad CLI functional evidence; this packet must not touch those surfaces.

The active Script Runner and Cursor migration owners lease Workers script execution and provider composition respectively; this packet must remain entirely Models-owned and must not add Workers or Providers dependencies.
payload.requestedOutcome: Implement IMP-MOD-02 as the Models parent-private catalog under pkg/services/models/internal/services/catalog, composed only through the Models parent and its existing wire boundary. Provide deterministic scoped identity, supported operation, source, status, and readiness discovery through the accepted ListCatalog, GetCatalogModel, and GetModelReadiness root operations. Resolve every request through an open RuntimeScopeRef; reject missing, closed, stale, or foreign scopes with the existing distinct Models-owned classifications, return the existing unsupported/not-found classification for unknown models, and return detached immutable values with deterministic ordering. Preserve current managed-model identity, aliases only where already contractual, runtime configuration precedence, source metadata, readiness semantics, cancellation, and unavailable-catalog behavior. Keep construction inert and effects injected; the catalog may query Models-owned runtime/cache facts but must not expose local catalog assemblers, caches, hosts, runtime handles, filesystem paths, or nested service interfaces. Adapt the existing Models parent implementation to delegate to the private child without changing the public root contract. Retire or narrow only Models catalog/readiness compatibility implementation after parity is proved; do not remove deprecated public methods needed by separate consumer-migration packets. Do not implement IMP-MOD-03 assets, IMP-MOD-04 host supervision, leases, inference, Workers inference runners, provider adapters/catalog/conductor/session behavior, CLI manifests or commands, OpenAPI/generated clients, pkg/root, pkg/wire, pkg/initializer, UI, or broad functional-test topology. Require focused catalog and parent-composition tests for deterministic discovery, unsupported model, unavailable catalog, scope isolation and lifecycle failures, detached return values, readiness transitions, cancellation, and compatibility parity, plus gofmt, focused vet/lint, architecture/ownership checks, and the narrow Models test suites.

payload.title: Reassess Models owner-local packets after catalog migration
payload.requestedOutcome: Review the accepted IMP-MOD-02 implementation, Factory review, exact changed paths, focused tests, CI, merge, and Factory consumption. Reconcile all active priority queue state before deciding whether to release IMP-MOD-03 assets or another packet. Do not automatically advance: preserve the CLI, Workers, provider, Wire, OpenAPI, and broad-test ownership gates, and do not admit parallel Models work while this catalog packet remains non-terminal.
